svg.aria-label: Example Anomaly Radar terminal report for the demo project
svg.text: A fragment of the real output (text format, English). Full format — docs/REPORT_FORMAT.md; md/json examples — examples/.

g.text: $ lwc radar examples/demo-buggy-app
Anomaly Radar report · lwc-vibe 0.1.0 · Files scanned: 20 · Analyzers: requirements, architecture, implementation, security, process
Summary: Total findings 44
▲ [High] REQ-001-3062e862 Contradiction between requirements
Where: REQUIREMENTS.md:12
Observation: "Скидка … должна применяться ко всем позициям" contradicts "Скидка … не должна применяться к позициям со специальной ценой"
Status: probable issue · Source: rule
Recommended fix: Keep one requirement or specify the conditions under which each applies.
■ [Critical] SEC-002-865b349d Unsafe handling of user input
Where: src/api/server.js:39
Observation: Shell command built from a string: `execSync(`wkhtmltopdf ./reports/${req.query.date}.html out.pdf`)`
Status: probable issue · Source: rule
Recommended fix: Use parameterised queries, safe APIs (spawn with an argument array, textContent) and validation.
■ [Critical] PROC-005-5114eb44 Success claimed although the check failed
Observation: The last run of `node --test tests/` exited with code 1, yet claim "Implemented, tests pass" was made afterwards
Status: confirmed defect · Source: rule · Evidence: .lwc/evidence/run-20261019123000-a1b2c3.json
Recommended fix: Fix the problem and rerun the check before claiming success.
Suppressed: 2
○ IMPL-006-0a625acf Unused export — Suppressed, reason: the receipt functions are called dynamically from an HTML template
Findings with status "probable issue" and "warning" require manual verification. The source of every finding is stated explicitly.
